name: self-learn
//workspaces: apps/ is the deployable surfaces (today: the Next app), packages/ the libraries they share, services/ the long-lived processes and CLIs. tools/ is deliberately absent: manimkc and tldrawkc are git submodules with their own repos, lockfiles and toolchains, and listing them here would make npm try to install them as part of this tree.
//scripts: The web app's own scripts live in apps/web/package.json; the four below delegate to them so `npm run dev` from the repo root still does the obvious thing. lint, typecheck and test stay here because they span every workspace: one ESLint config and one vitest config cover the whole tree, and typecheck fans out through --workspaces.
//canvas: `${TLDRAWKC_ROOT:-tools/tldrawkc}` is the same variable services/catalog/src/env.ts reads, so this script and the diagram indexer can never end up running different builds of the tool. npm runs scripts through /bin/sh on macOS and Linux, which is every environment this repo targets, and the path is quoted because a data root with a space in it is a real thing.
